items.text: 65% of Vilniaus KM shots come at the rim or in the short paint, and only 16% are above-the-break threes, made at 13%. **Pack the paint and dare them.** Bagdonavičius takes 97% of his shots inside (1.43 points per shot); he is the one to wall off.
items.title: VKM don't shoot over you

items.text: VKM rebound **51% of their own misses**, the highest rate in this group. Against a team that won't beat you from outside, the real defensive job is the box-out after the first shot, not the first shot itself.
items.title: Their misses are a second chance

items.text: VKM allow only **0.66 points per possession after a made basket** but 1.24 after a steal. VKKM's turnovers are the hinge: opponents score 1.55 per possession after a VKKM live-ball turnover, about 14 such trips a game.
items.title: Make them play against a set defence

items.text: VKKM are −40 in third quarters across four games; VKM are −16 in first quarters and **+75 over the other three**. Both trends point the same way: a close half-time is not a close game unless VKKM change something at the break.
items.title: Watch the third quarter

items.text: VKKM are +38 in 26 possessions with **Smailys** in the Gagilas–Skunsman–Januška–Raulušaitis five, but their most-used five (with Margevičius and Bieliauskas) is −21 over 84. For VKM, the team is +37 per 100 with **Valančius** on and +1 with him off, though he takes only 10 shots a game.
items.title: The players the box score misses

items.text: Steponaitis (VKKM) calls 4.5 timeouts a game, usually in the middle of an opponent run (opponents 105–67 in the four trips before them), and the trips after them are still lost 55–62. Šležas (VKM) calls 2.3. **If VKM go on a run, the timeout comes fast**; whether it stops the run is the question.
items.title: Two benches, two habits

items.text: Šležas has his best five on the floor for the finish: Mileika, Šinkūnas, Norvaišas, Bliūdžius, Bilčius have **not been scored on** together. The 8–0 that cut this to three came from VKKM turnovers, not VKM shooting, and Steponaitis still hasn't used a timeout to break it.
items.evidence: That five: 8–0 over 17 possessions tonight. Q4 9:42–6:14: VKM 8–0, VKKM 4 turnovers + 4 misses

items.text: Both teams are living at the rim tonight, far more than usual, and VKKM are already in the bonus. **Every VKM drive now is two free throws or a layup.** VKKM's answer has to be walls in the gap, not reaches, for six minutes.
items.evidence: Rim share: VKKM 56% (usually 32%), VKM 55% (usually 33%). VKKM 4 team fouls in Q4
